about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: With over 3 years of experience in web development, I specialized in creating robust and scalable applications. My journey began with a passion for solving complex problems and evolved into a career dedicated to building exceptional digital experiences.
about.paragraph2: Currently, I am a full stack developer, with a primary focus on creating high-performance web solutions. I have experience with technologies such as Vue.js, React, React-Native, Node.js and Java, among others.
about.paragraph3: I am a lifelong learner, always attentive to the latest trends and best practices in the industry. I believe in the power of technology to transform businesses and lives, and this is my greatest daily motivation.

contact.title: Shall we work together?
contact.description: I am available for freelance projects and full-time opportunities. Let's create something amazing!

aboutMe.title: About Diovane Alves
aboutMe.paragraph1: With more than 3 years of experience in web development, I have been dedicated to creating robust, scalable applications aligned with real business needs.
aboutMe.paragraph2: My journey began with a curiosity to understand how things work behind the screen. Over time, that curiosity evolved into a passion for solving complex problems and turning ideas into efficient digital experiences.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I am currently seeking an opportunity as a full-stack developer, where I can apply my knowledge to build high-performance and well-structured web solutions. I have experience with Vue.js, React, Node.js, Java, Tailwind CSS, among other technologies.
aboutMe.paragraph4: Beyond development itself, I value best practices, architecture, API integrations, databases, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, following agile methodologies to consistently deliver results.
aboutMe.paragraph5: I am a lifelong learner, always attentive to new trends and continuously seeking growth. I believe in the power of technology to transform businesses and positively impact lives — that is my daily motivation.
